title: Knowledge Document Manifest Entry
description: Validates every entry in manifests/corpus_manifest.yaml at ingest time. A malformed entry is rejected loudly and never reaches the index — the same 'loud error at the boundary' pattern as src/cyberrisk/calibration.py.

id.description: Unique, namespaced by location: corpus/<domain>/<category>/<doc> (any depth)

domain.description: Must match a value in manifests/domains.yaml

license_tier.description: Drives embedding choice, gitignore handling, and retrieval scope

content_hash.description: sha256 of the source file; derived/state uses it to skip unchanged documents

publication_date.description: When the source was published (optional; falls back to acquired_at in the vector store metadata)

industry.description: Industry key from industry_taxonomy.yaml, e.g. 'healthcare', 'finance' (optional; a generic doc has none)

taxonomy.description: Uniform subcategory keys this document covers, e.g. ['regulatory', 'insurance-claims'] (optional)

embed_model.description: Model key resolved per tier in pipelines/embed; licensed & confidential content must use a local model

status.description: deprecated content is excluded from retrieval; example entries are not live
